steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Welcome... welcome to my personal photo exhibition!

steps.speaker: Spectator A
steps.content: You truly live up to your reputation as a famous travel photographer. You've traveled to so many places and captured so many beautiful sceneries!

steps.speaker: Spectator B
steps.content: The photographs are so powerful... vibrant... and lively...

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Re-really? Thank you... I'm glad you like them!

This part of theater has been transformed into a bright exhibition hall. You carefully examine the photos; Syndicate, WhiteSands, Outlands... Photos taken from all kinds of places, the photographer sure is a free traveler.
Ugh, this is so boring... Travel photographer, huh... These pictures are far from exciting!
A discordant voice interrupts your thoughts. A man rudely critiques the photos, causing other viewers to frown and avoid him. Lynn, however, walks straight towards him.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: I'm sorry, but you're severely affecting others' viewing experience. Please leave immediately!

steps.speaker: Spectator C
steps.content: Why should I? I am just providing criticism for poor photography, kiddo.
The man is about to shove Lynn. Just as you're about to intervene, Lynn grabs his arm and stops him.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: I... I can travel through Syndicate and WhiteSands by myself. Even... even gangs and desert bandits dare not provoke me in my journey! You... you're no match for me!
Lynn stammers out her powerful lines, occasionally glancing your way. She swings lightly, and the man immediately falls to the ground dramatically, making a scene out of it.
His fake groan is drowned out by the applause of the crowd. Eventually, he gets up as he holds his stomach in embarrassment, and slowly walks out of sight.
